gui.gtcalcboard.guide.basics_desc:
### Canvas Navigation & Zooming
- [Right-Click / Middle-Click Drag]: Freely pan and move the canvas.
- [Scroll Mouse Wheel]: Smoothly zoom in/out between 0.2x and 3.0x.
- Top [⊕ Center] Button: Reset viewport back to the origin coordinates.

### Adding Recipes to the Board
1. In the EMI item list, hover over any item and press [R] (Recipes) or [U] (Uses).
2. Click the [+] button on the recipe screen to immediately place the machine node onto the board.
3. Alternatively, click the top [➕ Add] button to search and pick recipes directly from the search dialog.

> 💡 TIP: Resize Cards: Drag the bottom-right corner [◢] of any machine card to freely expand its width and height.
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.wiring_title: ⚡ Chapter 2. Wiring & Shift-Drag Auto Ratio Matching
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.wiring_desc:
### Basic Wire Connections
- Left-click the [Green Output Port] on a supplier machine, then left-click the [Blue Input Port] on a consumer machine to create a fluid/item connection wire.

### ✨ Shift + Drag Wire Connection (Auto Ratio)
- Hold down [Shift] while connecting an output port to an input port!
- The board will instantly analyze supplier production vs consumer consumption and [automatically calculate & scale the consumer machine count] so production and consumption match 1:1.
- Example: Connect a Chemical Reactor producing 500 mB/s to a Distillation Tower consuming 100 mB/s with Shift $\rightarrow$ Distillation Tower count becomes [5.0 machines] automatically!

### Disconnecting Wires
- [Right-click] directly on any wire curve or right-click any connected port to sever the connection.
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.master_title: 🎯 Chapter 3. Base Master Anchor & Auto Ratio
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.master_desc:
### Base Master Anchor Recipe
- In a multi-step production line, click the [🎯] button on the top-right of your final target product machine.
- The machine card will glow [Golden] and serve as the fixed anchor for the entire flowchart.

### Automation Toolbar Tools
- [⚖ Auto Ratio (Ratio)]: Scales and balances all upstream supplier machines backwards throughout the entire line to match the Master Anchor's exact requirement.
- [⚡ Auto Connect (Connect)]: Automatically scans all nodes on the canvas and wires matching item/fluid ports.
- [🚀 Max Flow (Flow)]: Overclocks all nodes to MAX tier and optimizes parallel hatches to compact huge lines into single high-throughput units.

> 💡 TIP: Click [Tier], [STD/PERF OC], [/2], or [x2] on any card to test individual overclocking and parallel efficiency.
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.module_desc:
### What is a Compound Module?
- A feature that condenses dozens of interconnected chemical reactors, distillation towers, and centrifuges into a [Single Compound Module Card].

### Key Benefits of Modularization
1. [Automatic Byproduct Encapsulation]: 100% self-recycled and internally consumed intermediate fluids/items are hidden, exposing only [Raw External Inputs] and [Net Final Outputs].
2. [Proportional Scaling]: Increasing the module card count (e.g. from 1 to 2 or 4) proportionally scales all internal facilities.
3. [Accurate Summary Stats]: Total contained machines (e.g. 58 machines) and power generation/consumption are properly aggregated in the Summary Overlay.

### [⤢ Expand] Instant Restoration
- Click the [⤢] button on the top-right of a module card at any time to restore all individual machines and internal wires onto the canvas.
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.shortcuts_title: 🖱️ Chapter 5. Marquee Box Selection, Clipboard, & Renaming
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.shortcuts_desc:
### Marquee Box Multi-Selection
- [Left-Click & Drag]: Draw a selection box on empty canvas to select multiple machines at once.
- [Shift + Left-Click]: Toggle individual machines into or out of selection.
- [Batch Dragging]: Dragging any selected machine moves all selected machines together while preserving internal wires.

### Undo, Redo, & Shortcuts
- [Ctrl + Z]: Undo the last action (moving nodes, adding/deleting, connecting wires, grouping, property edits).
- [Ctrl + Y / Ctrl + Shift + Z]: Redo the previously undone action.
- [Ctrl + X]: Cut selected machines and internal wires.
- [Ctrl + C]: Copy selected machines and internal wires to clipboard.
- [Ctrl + V]: Paste duplicated machines at mouse cursor position with new UUIDs.
- [Ctrl + D]: Duplicate selected machines instantly.
- [Delete / Backspace]: Delete selected machines and connections.
- [Ctrl + A]: Select all machines on the canvas.

### Inline Title Renaming
- [Double-Click] any machine header title to open the inline text editor.
- Type your custom name (e.g. [Sulfuric Acid Line 1], [Turbine Generator]) and press [Enter] to save.
gui.gtcalcboard.guide.pages_desc:
### Top Page Tab Bar (Presets)
- Organize your builds into separate, independent flowcharts via the top tab bar.
- [+] Button: Create a new blank board page.
- [Click Tab]: Instantly switch pages (remembers camera pan & zoom per page).
- [Right-Click Tab]: Rename the tab inline.
- [x Button]: Remove unwanted tabs.

### Saving & Blueprint Sharing
- [💾 Save] / [📂 Load]: Persistently save all tabs and configurations into calcboard_save.nbt.
- [📋 Share]: Export the entire flowsheet into a compressed [Text Blueprint Code] copied to clipboard.
- [📥 Import]: Paste a shared blueprint code from friends or the web.

> 💡 TIP: Your progress is automatically preserved even if you exit Minecraft!
